content.short: Coinbase Pay offers a widget to sign in to Coinbase and use saved payments or crypto balance in self-custody wallets and dapps.
content.description: Coinbase Pay provides an SDK and UI widget that enables users to sign in to their Coinbase account and access their saved payment methods or crypto balance for use with self-custody wallets or decentralized applications. This fiat-to-crypto conversion simplifies Web3 workflows, making interactions with wallets and dapps more intuitive and accessible as users move between traditional finance and the blockchain. The integration keeps the sign-in and funding flow aligned with Coinbase’s ecosystem, bridging fiat and crypto within the Web3 experience.
content.meta: Coinbase Pay is a widget to sign in to Coinbase and use saved payments or crypto balance. Discover Coinbase Pay and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
